# 4天用AI写代码，4周入账1.2万美元：这对双胞胎的疯狂实验

![封面图](https://storage.googleapis.com/indie-hackers.appspot.com/post-images/HxoUuTymcPNvhCNe8b6A/vOqaQ3DJwYRP8MNEjUOSMger71w1/sebastian-volkis-founder-of-trendfeed.png)

你想过用AI写代码吗？

不是辅助，

是完全让AI写。

Sebastian Volkis做到了。

他和他的双胞胎兄弟Matthew，

4天建了一个产品。

全部代码由AI生成。

4周收入1.2万美元。

听起来像 fiction？

这是真事。

**【从物理学到媒体采购】**

Sebastian大学学的是物理和天体物理。

挺酷的专业。

但他不喜欢。

毕业后做自由职业媒体采购（media buyer）。

 hated it。

辞职。

失业六个月。

 figuring out 怎么建App。

**【第一个App：ChatIQ.ai】**

他发现了AI coding工具——

Bubble（no-code平台）。

用Bubble建了第一个App：ChatIQ.ai。

两个月做到月入7500英镑（约9700美元）。

但问题来了——

他加功能的速度跟不上竞争对手。

没有技术背景，

每次改东西都慢。

用户开始流失，

转去用竞争对手的产品。

他开始用GPT-4写Python API，

扩展Bubble的功能。

能work，

但慢，

而且bug很多。

他意识到——

必须学会 full-stack coding。

但不想花几个月从头学。

**【AI教我写代码】**

既然GPT-4能写API，

为什么不能写整个App？

Sebastian开始实验——

用AI + Next.js建了一堆micro-SaaS。

练手。

练到他能判断——

AI写的代码安不安全，

效率高不高，

能不能跑 production。

这时候，

他的双胞胎兄弟Matthew来了。

Matthew说：

"咱们组队吧。

我负责营销，你负责产品。

目标：90天内建一个SaaS并卖掉。"

**【TrendFeed.app：4天上线】**

他们开始做TrendFeed.app。

一个聚合病毒新闻、

自动生成短视频内容的工具。

为什么做这个？

因为新手最有效的 get traction 方式，

就是用病毒 trending news 带来 views。

TrendFeed就是干这个的——

抓取新闻文章，

算法评估 viral potential，

然后给用户工具自动化内容创作。

Sebastian不想做又一个 generic AI视频工具。

市场上几百个，

大多数没特色。

他们专注在——

分析 credible sources，

用AI识别 viral trends，

从新闻里 compile 视觉素材，

生成高质量的、

人们真的想在Instagram和TikTok上看的内容。

给自己一周时间上线。

Sebastian用4天建了MVP。

全部代码AI生成。

Matthew那周在干嘛？

用Instagram、email list、

新注册的TrendFeed账号，

给 launch event 引流。

也推了一些他自己的Instagram流量。

2月27日上线。

 webinar 卖终身 deal。

 launch 当天收入5500英镑。

之后他们一直在 grow TrendFeed的社交账号，

这样以后就不用靠个人品牌 marketing 了。

产品 overhaul 了很多，

加了很多新功能，

开始收年费订阅。

前4周收入9222英镑（约1.2万美元）。

**【不是又一个"vibe-coded" App】**

Sebastian特别强调——

这不是那种随便 vibe code（跟着感觉写）的App，

上线就崩。

整个 build 过程中，

他都 focus 在 security measures。

引导AI模型确保产品结构正确。

没有手写代码，

但他得清楚怎么 structure App才能work。

还有很多要做，

但早期用户很 patient，

给了 incredibly useful 的反馈。

他用Bubble开始建App。

Bubble对理解SaaS、快速 launch 很有用，

但慢、bug多、而且你不拥有代码。

TrendFeed完全用AI生成代码。

Next.js、React（UI用ShadCN）、

Supabase（数据库）、

Vercel（部署）。

栈在进化——

现在在集成Clerk（用户认证）、

Whop（支付）。

因为App完全用AI生成代码，

Sebastian知道有开发者喜欢 poke around、

hack "vibe-coded" Apps。

他完全 expect 有人 try hack TrendFeed。

这就是他选Clerk的原因——

security features 强。

也是他花20-40%时间研究、

实施 security 的原因。

幸好之前项目有 solid foundation。

**【Launch to a following】**

他们的 launch 其实很简单。

知道会通过 live sales event（webinar）卖，

只需要 leads。

三年前 launch ChatIQ的时候，

他用TikTok，

发短视频广告展示产品功能。

抓住了ChatGPT的 massive trend，

零营销预算 bootstrap 到7500英镑MRR。

所以他知道——

如果 launch 新东西，

需要 audience。

他花了两年时间专注建 audience。

Instagram、TikTok、YouTube。

现在分别有5万、3万、4千粉丝。

TrendFeed第一批 leads 就来自这些账号。

但——

他们 want exit TrendFeed，

所以做的一切都是为了卖的时候 get best possible multiplier。

这意味着不能通过个人品牌 scale SaaS。

所以 launch 后，

把所有 marketing 转到新的TrendFeed社交账号。

结果——

收入大跌。

这个收入 drop 直接和 views drop 相关。

100粉的账号，

不可能 compete with 5万粉的账号，

至少前几周不行。

但会随着账号成长而 scale。

sales funnel 已经调好了。

现在只需要更多 traffic。

计划通过 influencers、雇 creators、

最终 run ads 来 scale。

**【Webinar是秘密武器】**

他说很多人 jump into 短视频，

以为这是 marketing 的 magic bullet。

确实可以是——

他第一个SaaS ChatIQ就是——

但只在你把 trends 直接 tie 到产品上的时候work。

否则需要更多 effort。

Consistency（坚持）是 cliché，

但是唯一保证长期增长的策略。

他们的 launch 收入 impossible without webinar funnel。

他们做webinar好几年了，

refined 成了一门艺术。

但起点是读 Russell Brunson 的《Expert Secrets》。

不过——

webinar很难。

过去12个月，

他 outside of TrendFeed 的业务做了35个不同版本的webinar。

每个300多页幻灯片。

工作量巨大。

对大多数 beginner，

每周 run live demo 也能有 similar results——

注册 leads，

 walk 他们 through 问题和SaaS怎么解决。

只要20个 leads 参加 live demo，

就能 massively increase 转化率。

实时处理 objections，

 live setting 里建立信任。

他们现在 closed beta，

网站上没法 browse 或 try tool。

 intentional。

想通过webinar控制 sales process，

这样转化率最高。

不是最传统的 approach，

因为网站 focus 在 collect leads for free training event，

很多人一开始不信TrendFeed是真的产品，

以为只是卖 course。

未来计划 release 免费 plan，

给5个 credits test App。

**【控制销售过程有多重要？】**

来对比一下数字。

他们的 launch 卖了22个客户，

249英镑终身 deal。

250个 leads，400个点击。

收入超过5500英镑。

现在看传统SaaS funnel——

同样400点击，

5%转免费用户，

10%免费转付费，

20英镑/月。

20个免费用户，

2个付费用户，

40英镑/月收入。

to match 他们的 launch 收入，

需要5.2万点击。

Launch 的时候，

获取 traffic 很难。

别把 traffic 发到被动 landing page 配支付链接——

你失去了对 sales 的控制。

那种 setup scale 大了可以work，

但早期每个 lead 都重要。

每个访问你网站的人都是潜在客户。

 Worst case，不喜欢 product 就 refund。

**【内容要卖 offer，不是卖产品】**

最后——

确保你的内容卖的是 offer，不是 product。

视频不应该是 SaaS 的广告。

想想你 scroll past 或 skip 广告多少次，

feed 里出现广告多烦人。

如果你的内容看起来像广告，

人们会 scroll right past。

相反——

 entertain。

 add controversy。

用问题 hook 人，

然后卖 lead magnet。

错误示范：

展示怎么使用 App 或 App 做什么的视频 demo。

正确示范：

展示你的 App 解决的 frustration。

让观众 relate。

然后提供 lead magnet——

比如免费课程，教怎么解决那个 frustration。

把 leads 推进 live demo 或 sales event，

在那里 close sale。

**【70%时间在营销和销售】**

Sebastian看到大多数 beginner 做什么？

把产品 launch 到 void 里，

 overengineer 一切。

产品 launch 的时候不需要 amazing。

你建了 great thing 不意味着它会在X上 automatically go viral。

你看到的每个 viral launch post 背后，

同一天有1万个失败的 launch。

Focus on distribution（分发）。

建高转化率的 sales funnel。

如果不能 scale content 的 views，

 focus 在提高转化率上。

70%的时间应该花在 marketing 和 sales 上。

给不存在的用户建 feature 没有意义。

最重要的是——

 give it time。

TrendFeed第一个月做到9000英镑，

但那基于十年的 learning 和 honing skills。

别忘了幕后发生的工作。

**【你会用AI建SaaS吗？】**

Sebastian的故事是个 blueprint——

怎么用AI写代码，

怎么 launch 到 audience，

怎么用webinar funnel convert，

为什么要 control sales process。

但最重要的是——

他用AI写代码，

但他懂 structure，懂 security，

懂怎么 guide AI。

AI是工具，不是 replacement。

你会用AI建你的下一个产品吗？

还是还在等"学会编程"？

也许——

你不需要会编程了。

你需要的是——

知道怎么让AI为你编程。

以及，

怎么把建出来的东西卖出去。

*P.S. 想看TrendFeed怎么自动生成内容？

去trendfeed.app看看。

说不定你的下一个 viral video，

就不用自己想破脑袋了。*

**

Writing code with AI in 4 days, earning $12,000 in 4 weeks: The twins 'crazy experiment

Have you ever thought about using AI to write code?

Not auxiliary,

Let AI write completely.

Sebastian Volkis did it.

He and his twin brother Matthew,

A product was built in 4 days.

All code is generated by AI.

Earned $12,000 in four weeks.

Sounds like fiction?

This is a true story.

[From Physics to Media Procurement]

Sebastian University studied physics and astrophysics.

Cool professional.

But he didn't like it.

After graduation, I worked as a freelance media buyer.

hated it。

Resign.

Unemployment for six months.

Figuring out how to build an app.

[The first App: ChatIQ.ai]

He discovered the AI coding tool--

Bubble (no-code platform).

I built my first App with Bubble: ChatIQ.ai.

A monthly income of 7500 pounds (about 9700 US dollars) in two months.

But the problem comes--

He can't add functions faster than his competitors.

No technical background,

Change something slowly every time.

Users began to lose,

Switch to competitor products.

He started writing Python APIs in GPT-4,

Extend Bubble's capabilities.

Can work,

But slow,

And there are many bugs.

He realized--

You must learn full-stack coding.

But I don't want to spend months learning from scratch.

[AI taught me to write code]

Since GPT-4 can write APIs,

Why can't I write the entire App?

Sebastian started experimenting--

Build a bunch of micro-SaaS with AI + Next.js.

Practice your hands.

Train until he can judge--

Is the code written by AI safe?

High efficiency,

Can you run production?

At this time,

His twin brother Matthew arrived.

Matthew said:

"Let's team up.

I'm in charge of marketing, you're in charge of the product.

Goal: Build and sell a SaaS within 90 days. "

[TrendFeed.app: 4 Sky Lines]

They started making TrendFeed. app.

An aggregated virus news,

Tool to automatically generate Short Video content.

Why do you do this?

Because the most effective way for beginners to get traction,

It is to use the virus trending news to bring views.

That's what TrendFeed does--

Grab news articles and

Algorithm evaluates viral potential,

Then give users tools to automate content creation.

Sebastian doesn't want to make another generic AI video tool.

Hundreds of them on the market,

Most of them have no characteristics.

They focus on--

Analyze credible sources,

Use AI to identify viral trends,

Compile visual materials from the news,

Produce high-quality,

What people really want to see on Instagram and TikTok.

Give yourself a week to go online.

Sebastian built the MVP in 4 days.

All code AI generation.

What was Matthew doing that week?

Use Instagram, email list,

Newly registered TrendFeed account,

Drain the launch event.

He also posted some of his own Instagram traffic.

It will be launched on February 27.

Webinar sells lifetime deals.

Launch earned £ 5500 that day.

Since then, they have been on grow TrendFeed's social account,

In this way, you will no longer have to rely on personal brand marketing in the future.

Products overload a lot,

Many new features have been added,

Start charging an annual subscription.

The income in the first four weeks was 9222 pounds (about 12,000 US dollars).

[Not another "vibe-coded" App]

Sebastian particularly emphasized--

This is not the kind of App that simply vibe code (writes according to your feelings).

It breaks when it goes online.

Throughout the build process,

He focuses on security measures.

Guide AI models to ensure the correct product structure.

There is no handwritten code,

But he needs to know how to structure an App to work.

There is still a lot to be done,

But early users are patient and

Gives incredibly useful feedback.

He started building apps with Bubble.

Bubble is useful for understanding SaaS and launching quickly,

But slow, buggy, and you don't own the code.

TrendFeed uses AI to generate code entirely.

Next.js, React (ShadCN for UI),

Supabase (database),

Vercel (deployment).

Stack is evolving--

Now integrating Clerk (user authentication),

Whop (payment).

Because the App uses AI entirely to generate code,

Sebastian knows that some developers like poke around,

hack "vibe-coded" Apps。

He completely expects someone to try hack TrendFeed.

That's why he chose Clerk--

Security features are strong.

He also spent 20-40% of his time researching,

Reasons for implementing security.

Fortunately, the previous project had a solid foundation.

【Launch to a following】

Their launch is actually very simple.

Knowing that it would be sold through the live sales event (webinar),

Just need leads.

When launching ChatIQ three years ago,

He uses Tok,

Short Video are posted to showcase product functions.

Capturing ChatGPT's massive trend,

Zero marketing budget bootstrap to £ 7500 MRR.

So he knew--

If you launch something new,

You need audience.

He spent two years focusing on building audience.

Instagram、TikTok、YouTube。

Now there are 50,000, 30,000, and 4,000 fans respectively.

TrendFeed's first leads came from these accounts.

But--

They want exit TrendFeed,

So everything I do is to get the best possible multiplier when selling.

This means that you cannot scale SaaS through your personal brand.

So after launch,

Transfer all marketing to your new TrendFeed social account.

The result--

Income plummeted.

This income drop is directly related to views drop.

100 fan accounts,

It is impossible to compete with an account with 50,000 fans,

At least not for the first few weeks.

But it will scale as the account grows.

Sales funnel has been adjusted.

Now we just need more traffic.

Plan to work through influencers, hired creators,

Finally run ads to scale.

[Webinar is a secret weapon]

He said that many people jump into Short Video,

Thought this was a magic bullet for marketing.

It can indeed be--

His first SaaS ChatIQ was--

But only work when you tie trends directly to the product.

Otherwise, more effort is needed.

Persistence is cliché,

But the only strategy to ensure long-term growth.

Their launch revenue is impossible without webinar funnel.

They have been doing webinar for several years,

Refining became an art.

But the starting point is reading Russell Brunson's Expert Secrets.

But--

webinar is difficult.

Over the past 12 months,

His business outside of TrendFeed has made 35 different versions of webinar.

Each has more than 300 pages of slides.

The workload is huge.

For most beginners,

Weekly run live demo can also have similar results--

Register leads,

Walk them through the problem and how to solve SaaS.

As long as 20 leads participate in the live demo,

You can significantly increase conversion rate.

Process objects in real time,

Build trust in live setting.

They have now closed beta,

There is no way to browse or try tool on the website.

intentional。

Want to control the sales process through webinar,

This has the highest conversion rate.

Not the most traditional approach,

Because the website focuses on collecting leads for free training events,

Many people didn't believe that TrendFeed was a real product at first,

I thought I was just selling course.

Future plans release free plan,

Give 5 credits test apps.

[How important is it to control the sales process?]

Let's compare the numbers.

Their launch sold 22 customers,

£ 249 for a lifetime deal.

250 leads, 400 hits.

Income exceeds £ 5500.

Now look at the traditional SaaS funnel--

Also 0 clicks,

5% transfer to free users,

10% free transfer fee,

£ 20/month.

20 free users,

2 paying users,

£ 40/month income.

to match their launch income,

It requires 52,000 clicks.

During Launch,

Getting traffic is difficult.

Don't post traffic to the passive landing page with a payment link--

You lost control of sales.

The setup scale is large enough to work,

But in the early days, every lead was important.

Everyone who visits your website is a potential customer.

Worst case, refund if you don't like the product.

[The content is to sell offers, not products]

Finally--

Make sure your content is selling offers, not products.

Video should not be a SaaS advertisement.

Think about how many times you scroll past or skip ads,

It's annoying to see ads in feeds.

If your content looks like an advertisement,

People scroll right past.

Conversely--

entertain。

add controversy。

Use question hooks to

Then sell lead magnet.

Error demonstration:

A video demo that shows how to use the App or what the App does.

Correct demonstration:

Show the frustrations your App solves.

Let the audience relate.

Then provide lead magnet--

For example, free courses teach how to solve that friction.

Push leads into a live demo or sales event,

Close sale there.

[70% of the time is spent on marketing and sales]

What does Sebastian see most beginners do?

Launch the product into void,

overengineer everything.

There is no need to amaze when launching products.

Just because you built great thing doesn't mean it will automatically go viral on X.

Behind every viral launch post you see,

There were 10,000 failed launches on the same day.

Focus on distribution.

Build a sales funnel with high conversion rates.

If you cannot scale content views,

Focus on improving conversion rates.

70% of your time should be spent on marketing and sales.

There is no point in creating features for non-existent users.

The most important thing is--

give it time。

TrendFeed made £ 9000 in the first month,

But that's based on a decade of learning and honing skills.

Don't forget what's happening behind the scenes.

[Can you use AI to build SaaS?]

Sebastian's story is a blueprint--

How to write code with AI,

How to launch to audience,

How to use webinar funnel convert,

Why control the sales process.

But the most important thing is--

He uses AI to write code,

But he understands structure, security,

Know how to guide AI.

AI is a tool, not a replacement.

Will you use AI to build your next product?

Or are you still waiting to "learn to program"?

Maybe--

You don't need to know how to program.

What you need is--

Know how to get AI to program for you.

And,

How to sell what you build.

*P.S. Want to see how TrendFeed automatically generates content?

Check out trendfeed.app.

Maybe your next viral video,

You don't have to think hard. *

AIで4日間でコードを書き、4週間で12，000ドルを稼ぐ：双子のクレイジーな実験

AIでコードを書くことは？

補助なし、

完全にAIが書く。

セバスチャン·ヴォルキスがやった。

彼と彼の双子の兄弟マシューは、

4日間で製品を作りました。

すべてのコードはAIによって生成される。

4週間で12，000ドル。

フィクションのように聞こえますか？

これは真実です。

物理学からメディア購入まで

セバスチャン大学では物理学と天体物理学を学んだ。

かなりクールなプロ。

でも彼はそうじゃない

卒业后はフリーランスのメディア买収media buyerをしている。

Hated itです。

辞任した。

6 ヶ月間失業。

アプリの作成方法を説明します。

最初のアプリ：ChatiQ.ai

彼はコーディングツールを見つけました。

Bubble（no-codeプラットフォーム）

Bubbleで最初のアプリChatIQ.aiを構築しました。

2 ヶ月で£ 7，500（約$9，700）を得ることができます。

しかし問題はここにあります

彼のスピードは競争相手に追いつくことができません。

技術的背景がない。

すべての変更はゆっくりです。

ユーザーが消え始め、

競合他社の製品に切り替えます。

彼はGPT-4でPython APIを書き始めた。

バブルの機能を拡張する。

働くことができる。

しかしゆっくりと、

バグも多い。

彼は気づいた-

フルスタックコーディングを学びます。

最初から何ヶ月も勉強したくない。

コードの書き方を教えてくれた。

GPT-4はAPIを書くことができる。

アプリ全体を作成しませんか？

セバスチャンは実験を始めた。

AI + Next.jsでマイクロSaaSを構築しました。

練習をする。

彼が判断できるように-

AIが書いたコードは安全ではない

効率が悪く、

生産を実行できますか？

この時、

双子の弟マシューが登場。

マシューは言う。

“チームを組みましょう。

私はマーケティングを担当し、あなたは製品を担当。
